name: Eternal Destination [UPDATE]
desc:
Welcome to Eternal Destination, a modded forsaken game (Using Aeternus engine).

• The game won't be closed due to some players but it won't receive any updates from me.

• This game is in development so expect bugs

¿What do you do?
• Survivalist: Try to survive the round while doing generators to make the time go away faster.

•⚔️Sentinel: Try to help your teammates by stunning the killer as: Shedletsky, Chance, Civilian, TorchWoodYT Guest1337, Fighter and Jane Doe. [And try to do generators if possible.]

•🔪Killer: Kill absolutely everyone that is in your sight.

¿Is this game being monetized?
• Of course not, I'm not getting money from assets that aren't mine.

• Bugs that are noted:
- Sometimes you spawn under the map
- You can't emote with Veeronica after the round ends while you're skating
